explication: AutoClip is an AI video-highlights application. The principal workflow is: a user submits a YouTube/Bilibili URL or local media, the API creates a project and asynchronous task, the six-stage pipeline analyzes content and generates clips/collections, then results and live progress appear in the UI. The README documents upload, account health, subtitle editing, exports, and real-time control. Some service wiring is inferred only from the documented architecture because source excerpts are partial.
